config.lsl.option.dh_exact_layers.desc: Draw layers in Distant Horizons LODs at their exact height (eighths of a block) instead of rounding them. Reaches into DH's internals, so it only switches on for the DH versions it was checked against (3.3.2 to 3.3.4); any other version uses the rounding below. Also patches DH's terrain shader and Iris's DH shader.
config.lsl.option.dh_exact_layers_color_: With exact layers: stores the eighths of a block in the lowest bits of the LOD colours instead of in DH's height fields, so exact heights also work in dimensions taller than 512 blocks (up to DH's own 4096 limit). Colours shift by at most 3/255. Only changes how LODs are drawn, never DH's saved data.
config.lsl.option.dh_layer_rounding.desc: The fallback when exact heights are off or this DH version is not supported. DH stores LODs in whole blocks and draws every layer as a full block, so distant terrain stands a block too high wherever there are layers. With this on, layers are rounded: Rounding Threshold eighths or more show as their full block, fewer as nothing (water if waterlogged). On a server, the server's own lsl.json decides for the LODs it builds.
config.lsl.option.dh_layer_rounding_thre: Layer height in eighths (1-8) from which a layer shows as a full block in rounded Distant Horizons LODs.
config.lsl.option.voxy_layer_mip.desc: Past the nearest Voxy LOD level, Voxy keeps the block under a layer and drops the layer: terrain rounds up to whole blocks and grass, sand or snow layer tops turn into the side of the block below. With this on, a distant cell topped by a layer becomes the same layer at the right height. Changes the LODs Voxy saves: existing ones keep their old look until Voxy rebuilds them (or in a new world). Only for the Voxy build LSL was checked against.
config.lsl.option.voxy_shape_culling.des: Voxy decides whether a block hides the face of the block next to it from how its model looks, not from its shape. A layer whose model fills its whole side (Conquest Reforged's overgrown layers with their grass fringe), or a stair Voxy draws as a smaller box, then hides its neighbour's face, and you see through the terrain in the LODs. With this on, a face only hides its neighbour when the block's shape covers that face and the block is drawn flush with its edges around it. Only changes how LODs are drawn.
config.lsl.option.voxy_plant_offset.desc: Conquest Reforged lowers its plants onto the layer under them, which Voxy ignores, so they float up to 7/8 of a block above it in the LODs. With this on, LSL lowers them in Voxy's nearest LOD level too. Only changes how LODs are drawn.
config.lsl.option.voxy_ground_plants.des: Also lower ordinary plants (vanilla and other mods) standing on a partial layer, the way AronaLayers-gen's plant grounding draws them. AUTO: on when AronaLayers-gen is installed. Plants on the bottom row of a Voxy section stay where they are.
config.lsl.option.voxy_hide_ext_blades.d: Leaves the diagonal grass blades of grass layers and grass blocks out of Voxy's LODs. Voxy flattens each block into six pictures, and from above those blades become a dark cross on every block, which turns into a moire pattern on distant meadows. Plants are not affected.
config.lsl.option.voxy_full_mipmaps.desc: Lets Voxy use all its texture mipmap levels even when the game's Mipmap Levels setting is lower. Without them distant LOD textures shimmer and form moire patterns. The game's own terrain is not affected.
config.lsl.option.voxy_match_tints.desc: Makes the biome colours of grass, leaves and plants in Voxy's LODs match the ones up close. Voxy works out each colour once per biome, as if the block stood at height 0 outside any world; Conquest Reforged's Polytone colormaps change colour with height, so distant plants came out in the wrong (underground) colours. With this on, colours are taken at a typical surface height (Y 72), and Polytone colormaps get the right biome.
config.lsl.option.voxy_ctm.desc: Bakes blocks with the textures Continuity gives them (connected and random textures) instead of their base textures. Voxy stores one look per block, so a plant gets its single-plant look and other blocks their fully connected look. Conquest Reforged's fescues need this: their base textures are pre-coloured, so in the LODs they came out too yellow or too dark.
config.lsl.option.voxy_ctm_repeat.desc: How LODs show full blocks whose connected texture is one large pattern spread over several blocks (Conquest Reforged's sandstones). Voxy keeps one look per block, so one piece of the pattern on every block would make a grid. AVERAGE: all pieces blended into one seamless texture (also covers slabs and other partial blocks). The first world load after a mod or resource pack change takes a few seconds longer while the pieces are baked; the results are kept on disk (lsl/ctm_average.bin) for later loads. BASE: the block's base texture.
config.lsl.option.voxy_split_large_quads: Cuts model faces bigger than a block into small pieces before Voxy bakes them. Voxy's baker overflows on large faces and drops them, so models that reach beyond their block, such as Conquest Reforged's lily pads, duckweed and reeds, came out missing or full of holes in the LODs.
config.lsl.option.voxy_flat_layers.desc: Draws the sides of layers as bright as their tops in Voxy's LODs. A slope of layers is a staircase of thin sides; shaded darker, each step draws a dark line, and far away those lines form moire patterns, most of all on sand beaches. Also works with a shaderpack: the pack is told the sides face up, so it lights them like the top.
config.lsl.option.voxy_draw_plants.desc: Off leaves grass, flowers and other plants out of Voxy's LODs altogether: the layer or block under them shows instead. Distant plants are thin cut-out shapes that shimmer against the ground behind them as you move; this removes that, at the cost of the plants themselves.
How far into its block, at least, Voxy draws each side of a plant. Voxy draws a plant as flat pictures, one per side, placed at the plant's outermost pixel; Conquest Reforged's plants reach almost to the block edge, so the pictures sat right against the sides of neighbouring layers and flickered against them. 0 leaves Voxy's placement; 0.25 is a quarter block.
config.lsl.option.voxy_tall_plants.desc: Draws plants whose model is taller than their block, such as Conquest Reforged's reeds and cattails, at their full height in every LOD. Voxy fits every block into its own cell, so otherwise only their bottom block shows, stretched in farther LODs.
config.lsl.option.voxy_plant_shading.des: Plant models are usually unshaded (Conquest Reforged's dense grass included), so Voxy draws them at full brightness while the game, near you, draws them much darker. With this on, Voxy shades plants by side like other blocks (sides at 80% and 60%), which darkens distant grass and flowers.
config.lsl.option.voxy_plant_shading_wit: Keeps Shade Plants (and Plant Brightness) on while an Iris shaderpack is active. Off by default, since shaders light the LODs themselves. Switching shaderpacks makes Voxy reload, which applies it.
Scales the colours of plants in Voxy's LODs when Shade Plants is on (and not turned off by a shaderpack): lower it if distant grass looks brighter than the grass near you, raise it if Shade Plants made it too dark (about 1.3 to 1.5 comes close to Shade Plants off). 1.0 leaves them as they are.
Colour strength of plants in Voxy's LODs, both their texture and their biome tint. Voxy works out the tint on its own, without the lighting and colour tweaks of the game's renderer, so plants such as Conquest Reforged's fescues can look far more colourful in the distance than up close: lower it to match. 1.0 leaves them as they are, 0 is grey.
